astro_fits_read — FILEIO fits op

• Data kinds: any → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.astro_fits_read(data) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.astro_fits_read(data); from the registry, opsfileio.get("astro_fits_read"))

Usage

Read a primary-HDU 2-D/3-D FITS image as (image_or_volume, meta).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

meta は bitpix、bzero、bscale と基本 WCS の wcs 辞書を持つ。切れたブロック、random groups、BLANK、次元・BITPIX・データ長の不一致は名指しで拒否する。

呼び出し例: image, meta = astro_fits_read(payload)。
